subject: Expedite log purge & escrow handoff for MediHealth Systems acquisition
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: shortened log purge window for MHS acquisition

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our legal/transaction team as we work through the asset transfer to AcquirerCo. Due to parent-company data migration requirements, AcquirerCo has requested that our log retention/purge window for a subset of operational logs be shortened from the standard 90 days to 30 days for two specific namespaces (auth events & API debug traces) during the 60-day closing window.

They also want an escrowed snapshot (immutable) of the 30-day logs to be held by a third-party escrow provider and for Redwood to sign a short DPA amendment confirming transfer scope and temporary retention exception.

I've attached a short request packet with the namespaces and sample retention table. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- expedite purge for those namespaces to 30 days during closing
- create an immutable escrow snapshot at close and provide the escrow manifest
- sign a DPA amendment limited to this transfer

We're trying to lock the operational checklist by EOD Friday (7/23). Can we schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow?

Thanks,
Evan Park
Director, IT Operations
MediHealth Systems
[attachment: MHS-retention-exception-request.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shortened log purge window for MHS acquisition

Evan — thanks for the details and the packet. Quick answers up front: we can evaluate an operational carve-out for the two namespaces and we do support generating escrowable snapshots, but there are a few policy/legal steps we need. Looping internal leads for ops, product security, and legal.

Can you share:
- exact S3 prefix or dataset IDs for the two namespaces (so ops can scope the purge)
- whether the escrow snapshot needs to be encrypted with the acquirer or with Redwood-managed keys
- confirmation that AcquirerCo will be the recipient of the escrow manifest and whether they require additional attestation (SOC2 or other)

I'll schedule a short sync for tomorrow 10:30am PT and include a proposed checklist.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shortened log purge window for MHS acquisition

On Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com> wrote:
> Due to parent-company data migration requirements, AcquirerCo has requested that our log retention/purge window for a subset of operational logs be shortened from the standard 90 days to 30 days...

Evan — thanks, this is operationally tractable but with constraints. High-level ops notes:
- We can implement a targeted TTL override for the two namespaces if you provide exact prefixes (S3 or bucket + prefix). It will be a policy change applied to the ingestion tier and the cold-storage pruning job.
- The earliest safe rollout for a manual override is 72 hours from approvals (space for testing and a backout plan).
- Creating an immutable escrow snapshot: we can export a point-in-time snapshot (gzipped tarball of logs + manifest). Redwood can push to a customer-supplied S3 bucket or a third-party escrow provider; encryption can be either Redwood KMS (we will share a wrap key) or customer-managed keys.

I've attached a short ops runbook with steps and a proposed 30/60/90 timeline for the purge and snapshot handoff — file: proposed-runbook.md. Key risks to call out: race with streaming ingestion (must pause pruning jobs for the targeted prefixes during export), and potential billing delta for extra snapshot storage.

Suggested next steps:
1) Customer provides prefixes and escrow contact
2) Legal approves scope (DPA amendment) and escrow manifest format
3) Ops schedules a maintenance window and test export

—Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed-runbook.md (text)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shortened log purge window for MHS acquisition

Laura / team / Evan — quick legal/compliance read. We can sign a scoped DPA amendment that allows a temporary retention exception and an escrow transfer, but we need the following covered in the amendment:
- precise dataset identifiers and a sunset date (no open-ended exceptions).
- who controls the encryption keys for the escrow snapshot and key-rotation obligations.
- requirements from AcquirerCo for attestations (if they require SOC2 attestation on the escrow provider, that must be documented).
- indemnities/limitations tied to retention exception (we prefer narrow liability carve-outs).

I've prepared an initial draft DPA amendment and attached it here: dpa-amendment-draft.docx. I'm also dropping a DocuSign envelope link for ease of execution once terms are agreed.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/EXAMPLE-SIGN

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal (Compliance Counsel)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: dpa-amendment-draft.docx (docx)]

From: Evan Park <evan.park@medihealthsys.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: shortened log purge window for MHS acquisition

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Answers:
- Prefixes: s3://mhs-prod-logs/auth-events/ and s3://mhs-prod-logs/api-debug/ (both in us-west-2)
- Escrow provider: CloudEscrow (escrow@escrowservices.com). They require Redwood to provide an export manifest and SHA256 checksums. They also ask that the snapshot be encrypted with a customer-supplied KMS key (we will provide).
- AcquirerCo requires a simple attestation letter confirming the snapshot integrity; they don't require an SOC2 re-audit for Redwood or CloudEscrow.

We'll plan to have the acquirer sign the DocuSign once we confirm a 7/23 handoff timeline. 

Evan
Director, IT Operations
MediHealth Systems

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: MHS expedite — confirmed prefixes and next steps

Team — internal action list after Evan's confirmation: 
1) Ops (Kim) to schedule a test export for s3://mhs-prod-logs/auth-events/ on 7/22 02:00–03:30 PT, pause pruning jobs for those prefixes, and produce gzipped tar + manifest + SHA256 checksums.
2) Legal (Karthik) to finalize DPA amendment with the provided sunset date of 2026-09-23 and add a short attestation template for AcquirerCo. Prepare DocuSign envelope for signatures.
3) Sales (me) to coordinate the escrow delivery point: CloudEscrow S3 endpoint and confirm they will accept customer-managed KMS AES-256 keys.
4) Eng Ops (Aditya) to estimate extra storage/egress cost and flag billing account change.

We are targeting handoff 7/23 EOD PT. If any of the above can't be met, flag immediately. I'll own communications with Evan and Sophie.

—Laura
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
notes: All internal participants are Redwood employees listed in /sources/gmail/; external participants are customer/acquirer/escrow contacts.
